description: This file defines the networking API for authentication-related operations in a Swift iOS application, including login, token refresh, logout, and fetching user info. It includes data models for request and response payloads, as well as a singleton class 'AuthAPI' that manages these operations asynchronously.

classes.name: AuthAPI
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for all authentication-related API calls, including login, token refresh, logout, and retrieving user info.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, retrieves tokens, and returns a TokenPair.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a refresh token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by invalidating the refresh token on the backend.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches user information for the authenticated user.

methods.name: mapTokenResponseToTokenPair
methods.description: Converts the backend's token response into a token pair with absolute expiration date.

methods.name: requireHTTP
methods.description: Ensures the URL response is an HTTPURLResponse, throwing an error otherwise.
